invariants: Physical unit instance identity is distinct from champion/catalog identity.
Board, bench, shop and pool are distinct ownership/availability domains.
Observed empty is distinct from missing, unknown, stale and incompatible.
Shop offers are snapshot-scoped opportunities, not owned unit instances.
Item catalog identity is distinct from physical item-instance identity.
Derived and estimated values retain formula, provenance, validity, quality and source sequence.
Candidate and anchor records are evidence proposals, not commands or confirmed active state.
Collection completeness is explicit; absent or empty arrays never silently imply a complete empty set.
Ordering is semantic and stable, never incidental container iteration or mutable catalog order.
Exact action masks remain separate identity-correlated side inputs; history never overrides legality.
Shadow recommendations, evaluator scores, baseline outputs, executor resolutions and diagnostic Unified Shadow state are not PPO observations or targets.

collection_status.complete: Producer attests all members in the declared scope were observed for this exact source sequence.
collection_status.partial: Some members are known, but completeness is not guaranteed.
collection_status.empty: Complete collection with zero members, explicitly observed.
collection_status.unknown: Producer cannot determine membership or completeness.
collection_status.missing: Collection was not supplied by the source.
collection_status.stale: Collection belongs to an earlier source sequence.
collection_status.incompatible: Schema, catalog or identity is incompatible with the consumer.
collection_status.not_applicable: Collection does not apply in this game state or phase.

entities.identity: Composite physical identity is (engine_instance_id, episode_id, player_id, uuid). UnitInstance::uuid is deterministic within an Engine episode factory and may repeat after reset; never use the raw UUID without its enclosing Engine/episode/player scope.
relationships: occupies one owned slot at a source sequence
groups by champion_id only for catalog/upgrade analysis
gaps: Unit.items currently contains catalog strings, not physical item-instance references.
UnitInstanceFactory::create() generates uuid from a seeded mt19937_64; TFTEngine::reset() reconstructs the factory from the same seed, repeating the first generated UUID across episodes.
UUID is exposed through diagnostic get_audit_snapshot(), not the PPO observation tensor/rollout.
Raw UUID is not globally unique and may repeat after reset; all joins must include engine_instance_id, episode_id and player_id from the enclosing snapshot envelope.
UUID is diagnostic/native snapshot identity and is not projected as a typed physical identity into PPO rollouts.
entities.native_identity_candidate: UnitInstance::uuid, valid only within the composite Engine/episode/player envelope

entities.invariant: Grouping/catalog key only; never a physical owned-copy identity.

Offer is not an owned unit instance or pool copy.

entities.identity: no physical item-instance identity; only item catalog ID strings stored in inventory/equipment containers
gaps: ItemEngine inventory stores std::string catalog IDs; no physical item-instance record or ID exists.
Equipped items are catalog IDs keyed by unit UUID; UnitInstance::items mirrors combat item catalog/API names, not item-instance references.
AuditSnapshot exposes catalog IDs only; no item-instance identity or typed item-owner relationship.
PPO receives numeric semantic rows and heuristic compatibility values, not raw item IDs, item-instance IDs, provenance or typed source sequence.

delivery.diagnostic: get_audit_snapshot exposes inventory catalog IDs and nested unit attachment catalog IDs; no item-instance ID
delivery.ppo: build_observations emits catalog-derived inventory semantic rows, equipped counts and heuristic fit features; no physical item ID or typed owner relation

entities.invariant: Catalog ID plus catalog fingerprint identifies a definition only; it never identifies a physical item copy.
Current count is an aggregate, not a list of physical component instances.
gaps: Repeated component catalog IDs in the vector preserve multiplicity but do not create independently identified physical component instances.
PPO observation emits one count per catalog component, normalized as clamp(count / 6, 0, 1); the current representation loses exact counts above the saturation ceiling.
Catalog order determines numeric feature positions and must be bound to the component catalog fingerprint/order.
The internal PvE component pool remaining count is loot-generation state, not player-owned component-instance identity or shared champion-pool availability.

entities.identity: option_index scoped to a pending ItemAnvil queue entry; no stable option_id or anvil identity is produced
gaps: ItemEngine can enqueue options through grant_component_anvil/grant_completed_item_anvil, but no caller was found in the audited TftEngine gameplay reward path.
The audited PvE reward path grants components and completed items directly; it does not create pending anvils.
The queue stores only kind and catalog-ID strings; there is no anvil ID, stable option_id, revision, producer event ID or source sequence.
The current consumer chooses by positional index and reuses the existing item action/mask head; a target-head sentinel is not a target entity.
The PPO anvil feature computes one best_fit maximum across all unit profiles (and recipe items for components), not per-target target_fits records.
Option-set completeness and pending-decision provenance are not produced.

entities.identity: trait_id + champion catalog fingerprint/order (fingerprint not currently emitted)
entities.invariant: Observed unit trait membership differs from active count, completed trait, core trait and strategic focus.
entities.status: native_catalog_membership_and_milestones; derived aggregates with distinct scopes; structured sequence-bound entity not produced
gaps: PPO build_observations counts catalog traits across board and bench, but its count_traits path does not include item.grants_trait.
StrategyInfo::active_traits is a distinct board-only count that unions catalog traits and item-granted traits once per UnitInstance.
Owned trait/core-trait counts use board plus bench and item-granted traits; core_traits is a derived top-three preference, not active trait state.
The SynergyCounter reward helper deduplicates by champion_internal_id, so duplicate physical copies contribute once; it is not equivalent to per-copy active trait counts.
Trait milestone levels, core_traits, composition_direction and focus weights are distinct derived/strategic signals and must not be collapsed.
PPO trait features are fixed numeric aggregates; no typed trait entity, field provenance, source sequence or catalog fingerprint/order envelope is delivered.
observation_trait_names is derived from champion catalog iteration; the ordering is not emitted as a separately versioned catalog contract.

delivery.diagnostic: StrategyInfo exposes active_traits/core_traits/direction/focus diagnostics with different scopes; no dedicated sequence-bound structured trait entity collection was established in the audited snapshot path.
delivery.ppo: Fixed numeric trait blocks: board+bench catalog membership counts divided by five and clamped; item-granted traits and typed provenance/sequence/catalog fingerprint are absent from this projection.

entities.identity: (engine_match_id, player_id, board_slot_index, source_sequence); canonical hex coordinate identity unavailable
gaps: The 28-slot board is interpreted internally as a 4x7 rectangular grid using slot / 7 and slot % 7; this does not prove canonical TFT hex coordinates, adjacency, orientation or enemy-facing semantics.
StrategicPositionSnapshot carries champion IDs rather than physical UnitInstance UUIDs; duplicate copies are ambiguous and skipped.
Role evidence is populated from active->candidate.units, not from a proven lineup.selected_board/entries/exits/deferred_target_ids integration chain.
Proposal searches empty targets only and does not perform implicit swaps; exact source/target slot and current native mask checks are present.
The proposal is read-only and does not prove executor acceptance or native action execution.
PPO receives aggregate positioning score, frontline/backline ratios and role diversity, not structured per-unit spatial entities or positioning proposals.
The full lineup-to-position-to-executor chain and exact sequence correlation require integrated replay evidence.

delivery.diagnostic: Shadow proposal DTO carries match/player/round/sequence, composition identity/version, champion ID, role, source zone/slot, target board slot, scores and reason; it lacks physical instance identity.
delivery.ppo: Aggregate positioning score, frontline/backline ratios and role diversity only; no per-unit spatial record, exact destination proposal or canonical hex coordinate.

entities.identity: no unit_instance_id is produced; current derived records are champion_id keyed or per-slot without UUID, so duplicate physical copies are ambiguous
entities.invariant: is_core, board_contribution, composition_fit and item_fit are derived/estimated, not observed unit facts.
gaps: StrategicSharedContext::owned_units is appended per occupied board/bench slot but carries champion_id and no UnitInstance::uuid or exact slot identity; duplicate copies cannot be joined unambiguously.
copies_owned is champion-aggregated; board_contribution, composition_fit and item_fit are heuristic/derived values with different formulas, not observed unit facts.

The separate UnitPriorityContext aggregates ownership by champion_id and UnitPrioritySnapshot emits champion-keyed assessments, including missing target champions; it is not a physical UnitInstance assessment.
No field-level formula/version, per-field quality/uncertainty envelope or typed source sequence is attached to each assessment.
No structured unit-assessment record is delivered through pybind or the PPO observation/rollout.

delivery.shadow: StrategicSharedContext::owned_units and UnitPrioritySnapshot are used in Shadow strategic/composition evaluation; records are champion-keyed and lack physical UUID identity.
delivery.ppo: No structured unit-assessment entity is delivered. Existing numeric observation features are separate legacy aggregates.

entities.identity: no emitted candidate_id or candidate_revision; generated composition identity plus parent producer snapshot sequence is the strongest available correlation, not a stable candidate-set identity
entities.invariant: Evidence proposal only; not an active composition, accepted pivot or command.
gaps: StrategicAnchorCandidate carries direction/composition identity, champion IDs, evidence strings and heuristic scores but no dedicated candidate_id, candidate revision or producer-local sequence.
The parent StrategicEvidenceContext carries match/player/round/sequence; that parent sequence does not establish immutable candidate-set identity or completeness.
Initial direction hypotheses, active direction anchors and pivot candidates are distinct records with different owners and lifecycle; they must not be collapsed into one anchor entity.
InitialStrategicDirectionDiscovery and pivot references use champion IDs rather than physical UnitInstance UUIDs.
Pivot candidate confidence is initialized to zero in the audited callsite; protected gold floor and transition economic cost remain unavailable.
Anchor and pivot records are serialized to Shadow diagnostics, not to the PPO observation tensor or rollout.

delivery.shadow: Native composition candidates feed StrategicSharedContext; exploratory hypotheses and pivot candidates are evaluated/serialized by UnifiedStrategicStateMachine and its diagnostic sidecar.
delivery.ppo: No typed anchor-candidate entity or candidate-set envelope is delivered.

entities.invariant: Child sell_value/affordability does not prove a complete parent candidate set exists.
gaps: StrategicSharedContext declares action_candidates, but the audited TftEngine construction path does not populate the vector before either evaluator runs.
Baseline and contextual evaluators therefore receive an empty source candidate set in the audited path; child sell-value/affordability features do not establish a complete parent candidate set.
Current diagnostic same_initial_candidate_set may be true for three empty lists, and comparison_available is computed from stale flags alone; both can misstate comparability when no candidate exists.
The approved contract requires at least one shared valid candidate identity before comparison_available can be true.
StrategicActionExecutor::resolve is invoked, but an empty candidate set does not establish a selected or accepted action.

delivery.shadow: Both evaluators consume the empty StrategicSharedContext::action_candidates vector in the audited TftEngine path; resolver call is wired and per-request resolution remains separate.
delivery.ppo: No action-opportunity candidate collection is delivered. Legacy sell-value/affordability child scalars do not form a candidate set.

entities.identity: no source_decision_sequence or event identity is produced for a structured decision-history collection; current memory is player/round and board-slot scoped
entities.invariant: Descriptive context only; never a mask or legality override.

delivery.diagnostic: No typed decision-history collection is exposed by the audited audit-snapshot or pybind path.

AntiLoopEngine::reset clears history while preserving accumulated metrics; begin_round clears position history, retains at most six move records, clears blocked moves and expires state visits outside the configured eight-round window.
AntiLoopEngine::get_state returns only history sizes and last_move; the audited TftEngine path does not call it or serialize the ordered history through get_audit_snapshot.
The pybind get_anti_loop_metrics endpoint exports aggregate counters, not position_history, move_history, blocked_moves or state_visits.
Anti-loop logic contributes to native move validation and action masks; this is a legality/control path, not a PPO history feature or a replacement for exact masks.

delivery.diagnostic: The Python binding exposes aggregate anti-loop metrics only; ordered history remains internal to the native per-player engine.
delivery.ppo: No anti-loop history entity is delivered. Native legality effects remain represented by the separate action-mask side input.

relationships.to: champion_catalog_entry (aggregate assessment; no physical UnitInstance identity)
champion_catalog_entry (champion references; physical instance join unavailable)

relationships.temporal: catalog scoped; observed unit membership snapshot scoped

temporal_rules: Every snapshot entity collection binds to exact observation snapshot sequence and match/player identity.
Decision-local history binds to exact decision sequence and episode; reset at declared episode boundary.
Shop offer identity expires when shop snapshot or reroll generation changes.
Unit instance identity persists across slot movement but not sale, elimination or new match.
Stale/cross-sequence records are rejected or marked stale; no latest-value fallback.
Partial collections preserve known records and explicit incompleteness; never treat as complete.
unresolved_schema_gaps: Shop has no explicit offer_id, offer revision/reroll generation or observed price field.
Inventory and unit attachments lack physical item_instance_id and explicit attachment owner references.

Pool availability has an authoritative shared-lobby native query and direct pybind surface, but no immutable decision-correlated snapshot, source sequence, wrapper observation delivery, PPO projection or dedicated Schema v2 field.
Board slot index lacks documented coordinate/orientation mapping.
Positioning and trait aggregates use open maps without complete typed key/catalog contracts.
Unit assessments and anchor candidates need explicit collection completeness and source-sequence contracts.
Action-opportunity producer is not populated; candidate rows remain withheld.

Physical unit UUID producer exists, but same-seed Engine reset repeats the first UUID; no match/player namespace or collision registry exists, so Schema v2 instance_id remains unverified as canonical identity.
Board slot indices and occupancy are native; canonical hex coordinate/orientation/adjacency mapping and exact source-sequence correlation are not proven.
Shop offer contents are produced in five slots, but no stable offer_id, offer revision or reroll-generation token is emitted; slot and temporary unit UUID are not sufficient offer identity.
Physical item copies are not produced: ItemEngine stores catalog ID strings in inventory/equipment containers and has no item_instance_id or typed owner relation.
Component copies are represented by repeated catalog IDs and aggregate counts only; no physical component-instance identity exists, and PPO count normalization saturates at count 6.
Anvil API/consumer exists, but no producer call was found in the audited TftEngine gameplay reward path; normal PvE rewards grant components/completed items directly.
Anvil option identity is positional only; no anvil ID, option_id, revision, completeness or source sequence is produced.
Anvil target fit is emitted as one heuristic best-fit maximum per option, not target-specific target_fits records.

Trait membership, item-granted traits, board-only active counts, board+bench owned counts, reward unique-champion counts, milestone levels and strategic core/focus signals have distinct semantics and must be modeled separately.
Trait catalog/order fingerprint is not carried with the current fixed PPO trait feature blocks.
Positioning uses a 4x7 rectangular slot convention; canonical TFT hex coordinates, orientation and adjacency remain unverified.
StrategicPositionPlanner identifies sources by champion_id, so duplicate physical copies are ambiguous and no UnitInstance UUID is carried.
The Shadow positioning proposal is not proven to consume the lineup selected_board/entries/exits/deferred_target_ids chain or to be accepted/executed by the executor.
PPO receives aggregate positioning diagnostics rather than structured per-unit positions and exact destination proposals.
Unit assessments exist only as champion-keyed/per-slot derived Shadow records without UnitInstance UUID; the declared unit_instance_id cannot be populated for duplicate physical copies.

Native anchor/composition candidates, early direction hypotheses, active direction anchors and pivot candidates have distinct producers/lifecycles; no stable candidate_id/revision or complete immutable candidate-set envelope is emitted.

StrategicSharedContext.action_candidates is not populated in the audited TftEngine path; evaluator diagnostics can currently report comparison_available for an empty set because the flag is based on staleness rather than non-empty shared candidate identity.
Temporal action memory reaches PPO only as normalized action-horizon and board-slot-age scalars; no typed decision event history or source_decision_sequence is delivered.

AntiLoopHistory is internal per-player state with bounded round/episode retention but no match/player/decision-sequence fields; get_state is not serialized by the audited TftEngine/pybind path, and Python receives aggregate metrics only.
validation_requirements: Every structured schema path maps to an entity kind or explicit aggregate/gap.
Every entity has identity, scope, ownership domain and source-sequence semantics.
No champion/catalog key is used as physical instance identity.
Empty, missing, unknown, partial, stale, incompatible and not-applicable are distinguishable.
Every derived/estimated field retains formula/provenance/quality requirements.
Every temporal collection has reset and stale rules.
All schema gaps are explicit and require versioned review before runtime use.
Board and bench slot indices are kept separate from physical unit identity; empty slots remain explicit and positional.
Shop offer identity is distinct from champion catalog identity, temporary UnitInstance UUID and mutable slot index; offer revision/source sequence is explicit before use.

Trait counts preserve board versus bench scope, catalog membership versus item-granted membership, physical-copy versus unique-champion semantics, and observed count versus milestone/core/focus derivations.
Trait feature ordering is bound to an explicit catalog identity/version before structured projection.
Position slot indices are not described as canonical hex coordinates without a validated orientation/adjacency mapping.

Position proposals carry exact source and target parameters, physical source identity when unambiguous, exact sequence/composition identity and native mask evidence; proposals remain distinct from executor resolution.

Unit assessment identity must not claim unit_instance_id until exact UUID/slot identity and duplicate-copy correlation are produced; champion-keyed priority aggregates remain a distinct derived entity.
Anchor candidate, exploratory direction hypothesis, active direction anchor and pivot candidate retain distinct producer, identity, lifecycle, completeness and source-sequence contracts.
Action comparison is unavailable for an empty candidate set even when evaluator objects are non-stale or candidate counts happen to match at zero.
Flat action-memory scalars remain distinct from typed decision history; board move age is slot-scoped, not physical-unit scoped.
Anti-loop history identity, retention/reset, Python exposure and mask relationship are explicit; exact native action masks remain independent final legality inputs.

architecture_reconstruction_review.prior_problem: The manifest classified pool availability as unavailable until an authoritative producer existed, but later source audits established UnitPool::available()/initial_count(), TFTEngine query methods and direct pybind exposure.
architecture_reconstruction_review.technical_justification: An authoritative point query is not an immutable pool snapshot correlated with the exact observation, masks and action. Treating the query as full observation delivery would overstate the current contract.
architecture_reconstruction_review.new_responsibility: The pool-availability entity entry records the native shared-lobby query capability and its delivery boundary; the Engine observation adapter and schema remain responsible for any future decision-bound snapshot.
contract_and_invariants: Pool counts remain shared-lobby state keyed by champion catalog identity.
Never infer pool availability from player-owned board, bench or shop state.
No decision sequence or PPO availability is claimed without an immutable correlated payload.
architecture_reconstruction_review.objective_validation: The manifest agrees with the producer coverage CSV and lifecycle follow-up: native query exists, delivery is direct-pybind-only, and PPO/snapshot delivery remains absent. No runtime, schema field, tensor or training behavior changes.
